column1: Feng Wei is a 'Jack of all trades, master of none' character who delivers extremely well when it comes down to poking at small distances with his jab strings "1,3", "1,2", "1,1", a psuedo homing mid "B+4" and a i14 "DF+1". Combining this with 'Evasive' moveset of Feng makes him a unique blend of evasive offense. Whole of his gameplan revolves arond instigating the opponent to retaliate into his poking after which Feng can retaliate back with his fast Counter-hit tools like "B+1", "1,1", "UF+2", highly rewarding parries like "F+1+2" and Back Kenpo "B+3+4" evasion. Even though Feng might look too good on paper, he is extremely balanced and has to take risks against defensive players be it by dashing or by choosing risky pokes like "DB+3" to keep the offense.

Feng is extremely beginner friendly, strong fundamental based character with enough "speciic' scenario based options that can be handy in alot of matchups (i.g Nina/Anna). If you're a fan of keeping up the high pace and high awareness in split second decisions, this character is built for you.
Pokes: Has one of the best arsenal of pokes if not the best. Variety of lows and mids extremely compatible to each other.
Strong Defensive Tools: Arguably the most risk-free rewarding stances in the game "F+3+4" and "B+3+4" on addition with other retaliation options such as "B+1" and "UF+2".
Ease Of Play: Simple commands promotes player to dive straight into mindgames rather than struggling with execution.
Has to engage in multiple interactions which requires strong awareness and may expose the player to counterhits.
